2226-2499-8306.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-8306.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Keymaster Rogue by paying its mana cost.
When Keymaster Rogue enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2103-7757-7758-7843.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
2103-7757-7758-7843.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Elrond.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Capture of Jingzhou.
Capture of Jingzhou's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-5220-5477-6961-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-5477-6961-7824.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

578-876-7070.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand.
578-876-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Metalworker.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Metalworker.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Metalworker.
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, revealing at least one artifact card from your hand and adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Metalworker.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Metalworker.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Metalworker from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

757-950-3094.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

969-1171-1409.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

413-3317-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
413-3317-5972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

851-4682-4772-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
851-4682-4772-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season and Adrix and Nev.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
851-4682-4772-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

11-1927-4084-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-1927-4084-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Part the Waterveil by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Part the Waterveil.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Part the Waterveil spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Part the Waterveil spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Part the Waterveil and returning the original Part the Waterveil to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Part the Waterveil from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1818-3490-4050-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-3490-4050-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3755-4222-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kragma Butcher.
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

539-4657-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
539-4657-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat.

7-1020-1117-6518.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
7-1020-1117-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-3693-3967-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
2060-3693-3967-5544-6431.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 3.
Repeat.

1247-4880-5536.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Weaver of Currents and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-4880-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Weaver of Currents's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1819-5510-5511-5514.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of copies of Persistent Petitioners in your library greater than your maximum hand size minus the number of cards in your hand.
1819-5510-5511-5514.description:
Cast Secret Salvage by paying {3}{B}{B}, exiling Persistent Petitioners from your graveyard and causing you to search your library for all copies of Persistent Petitioners in your library and put them into your hand.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard as many copies of Persistent Petitioners as possible.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card discarded this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
During the next player's turn, cast Surgical Extraction by paying {B/P}, exiling all copies of Persistent Petitioners from your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card exiled this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

204-1115-1858-2056-2633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1115-1858-2056-2633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

654-1671-2895-3497.notablePrerequisites: The amount of life you have gained this turn is equal to or greater than your commander tax plus one.
654-1671-2895-3497.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Uro from the command zone by paying {G}{U}.
Uro enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Choose to return Uro to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain three life, draw a card, and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1703-4050-4984.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it triggers, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Repeat.

141-3269-4050.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Naru Meha enters the battlefield, creating a copy of Ascend from Avernus.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the copy of Ascend from Avernus, returning all creature and planeswalker cards with mana value four or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

301-687-2034-3220.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
301-687-2034-3220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Putrid Goblin dies, triggering its persist ability and Golgari Germination.
Resolve the Putrid Goblin trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both counters from Putrid Goblin and the counter from the Saproling token, causing yourself to mill three cards and allowing you to return a permanent card with mana value three or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1912-2816-3201.notablePrerequisites:
Arixmethes is a creaure and does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Arixmethes.
1912-2816-3201.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Arixmethes by paying {1} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
